title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00376313686053 (+1.59198341e-6 over #7713)
body:
The fixed two-split composition from [PR #7716](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7716) has a **complete conditional application with κ ≥ 0.00376313686053**. This exceeds the certified upper value `0.00376154487712` of [PR #7713](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7713) by `0.00000159198341`. The raw crossing is in `(0.00376313686061, 0.00376313686062)`. [Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/586f4f81a8bd09a65a8e6d0bfff57a0fec8925e8/research/quotient-split-physical-application/PROOF.md) · [Complete application receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/586f4f81a8bd09a65a8e6d0bfff57a0fec8925e8/research/quotient-split-physical-application/results/application.json) · [Source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/586f4f81a8bd09a65a8e6d0bfff57a0fec8925e8/research/quotient-split-physical-application/SOURCE-PINS.json) · [Credit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/586f4f81a8bd09a65a8e6d0bfff57a0fec8925e8/research/quotient-split-physical-application/CREDITS.md)

The new result resolves the composition's open physical, signed-operator and ordinary/compiler bill. It retains the exact graph `5183479ecac34a1cb5c046f202e19d7161679265fe121b4a0af922fe344d8fc1`, all 6,054 paid routes, 1,470 public fields and 1,070 helper owners. Its normalized construction is prior work. The complete 16-call invoice has 100,416 paid jobs and 20,656 productive jobs, with rank masses 268,368 and 269,696. Both surrendered rank-nine targets are debited.

| Implementation quantity | Parent | Composition |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Scalar terms per native call | 175927 | 178845 |
| Sufficient common grid | `2025*2^20` | `2083725*2^20` |
| Numerical homes per native call | 8995 | 8999 |
| Reset services per native call | 1503562 | 1526938 |
| Selected transfer legs per native call | 409094 | 414942 |
| Scalar services across 16 calls | 123312128 | 124816384 |
| Scalar steps per padded cell per service | `2^21` | `2^29` |

The 21-bit odd conversion raises the conservative scalar rate by a factor of 256. The complete cost account includes that finite constant, every added scalar term, guards, guide setup/retirement, full-view storage and movement. The conditional asymptotic compiler permits its cutoff to depend on these constants. **No practical speed improvement or useful numerical cutoff is claimed.** The temporary padding stays `W+26` within the retained 24-bit scalar limit.

All 1,470 endpoints, 9,966,426 exact products and 5,312,755 nontrivial divisions pass. The checker binds all signed main and stage-specific helper owners. It rejects an aliased main owner, missing factors three/five/seven, a parked-sender overwrite and a partial payload clear. The storage fixture has four addresses per home; arbitrary-width execution uses the inherited owned-erasure and tape laws. It is not inferred from that finite fixture alone.

All 2,962 ordered paid/helper pairs pass signed Pauli and absolute-phase checks. Seven dense pairs include all four split routes, with 7,168 forward/adjoint columns. All 104 main adapters and 1,664 stage contacts pass, including phase-omission controls. [Catalogue checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/586f4f81a8bd09a65a8e6d0bfff57a0fec8925e8/research/quotient-split-physical-application/catalogue.py)

Directed 256-bit power bounds and a separate 80-decimal interval engine check the crossing. At probe `0.00376313686060`, the finite compiler gives `H=14708600000000000000`; all 54 strict inequalities, four functional constraints, input lift and common-root depth guard pass. The conservative BIT bound stays `0.00376669`. The five inherited assumptions remain: native realization on all columns, owned erasure, compiler, fixed-tape precision/movement and analytic recovery. A materialized all-size rounded multiplier, independent human review and formal-kernel acceptance remain open. The selected frontier is unchanged.

The historical [local-word packing ceiling](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/research/complex-local-word-ceiling/ceiling.py) assumes a nine-stage hosted template, its one-unpaid-coordinate coverage identity and the balanced outer conversion. This 16-stage caller with independent productive helper returns uses a different coverage and outer contract. That packing ceiling does not apply. The replacement bound is the strictly decreasing complete signed-invoice crossing above: its upper value is `0.00376313686062`, and the claimed lower point realizes more than `99.9999999976%` of that fixed-invoice upper value. This fraction does not bound a changed invoice or graph.

Use CPython 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/quotient-split-physical-application
```

The final line is:

```text
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/quotient-split-physical-application outcome=completed
```

The registered application and three serial catalogue shards, exact retained bytes, committed bytes/modes, source history, export and sealed Git-free read-only replay pass. Optimized execution is rejected because retained source assertions are required. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44350596429/job/134964837022) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence. Complete predecessor suites, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. This is author checking with reused engines, not blind or independent human review.

Base is refreshed canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. The source composition is `1636b3c9b922d23b222b60dd52e005e60c592491`. The application wrappers adapt [PR #7713's source](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/06b75fde21f4231a2bd0725542c3ba60a908d83b/research/p104-helper-quotients/application.py) at scientific commit `06b75fde21f4231a2bd0725542c3ba60a908d83b`. Clear1nsight's unchanged [physical engine](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e29a5ae8591243c1178067727f12ce4abefa0b93/research/cf6a-banked-role1256-relay/physical.py) and [whole-view argument](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e29a5ae8591243c1178067727f12ce4abefa0b93/research/cf6a-banked-role1256-relay/PHYSICAL.md) supply the banked execution. The new interface reader checks actual compact labels; no frozen check is patched or disabled.

Credit @DreamingOfClouds for the literal split witnesses and Claude Opus 5.5-assisted construction in [PR #7712](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7712), Clear1nsight for the split method and banked execution, Ali Romman for the restrictions, composition and application, SYLforge for the word and signed caller, and Rohan Arun, Jerry Chen / CubeJerry, Douglas Colkitt, mightyOil and the credited contributors for the framework. All supplier and operator notices are retained. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.

The [canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19712843) is limited to this fixed graph. Fresh Discussion and updated-order PR deltas were checked against complete snapshots; the full open refresh timeout is recorded. Sparse local and unpublished work remain overlap limits. This does not take the separate joint-removal search. No follow-up is reserved.
